Chunk.text:
# Kickoff meeting

Orion Tech Club, first meeting of the term. Project name: ClubConnect, a small web app for club events and member sign-ups.
Chunk.author: Meera

Chunk.text:
## Attendees

Meera (lead), Riya, Karan, Aman.
Chunk.author: Meera

Chunk.text:
## Scope

Event pages, member sign-up and a reporting page for the treasurer. No mobile app this term.
Chunk.author: Meera

Chunk.text:
## Frontend

Decision: frontend will be React with Vite, fast to set up and everyone has used it.
Chunk.author: Meera

Chunk.text:
## Hosting

Look for free hosting first. Riya will check the options and report back.
Chunk.author: Meera

Chunk.text:
## Action items

- Riya: set up the repository and CI.
- Karan: start the login page.
- Aman: sketch the reporting page.
Chunk.author: Meera

Chunk.text:
# Sprint review

Third meeting. Karan, Aman, Riya and Meera present.
Chunk.author: Meera

Chunk.text:
## Demo

Event pages work. Sign-up form is half done. Reporting page is only a mock-up so far.
Chunk.author: Meera

Chunk.text:
## Database

Decision: going with Postgres, the reporting queries need joins. Aman will write the schema.
Chunk.author: Meera

Chunk.text:
## Risks

The treasurer wants totals per event, so the reporting page cannot be dropped.
Chunk.author: Meera

Chunk.text:
## Next steps

- Aman: schema and first migration.
- Karan: finish the sign-up form.
Chunk.author: Meera
